experiment_version_scope: Multiple explicitly labelled development versions trident-1.0 through trident-1.3; no best-of-versions performance table

full_raw_archive.location_kind: conversation attachment, not a GitHub Release asset

seed_response_policy: Twenty original seed responses remain in the full archive. Git includes the actual two-field plans and metadata. Host runs evaluate available seed plans at their target q/n inside the configuration budget.
publication_materialization: Literal recorded numeric sequences and CSV strings are expanded losslessly; no evaluator or solver runs during file publication. Publication receipts contain actual expanded file sizes/counts.
raw: Complete raw candidate/request/plan/official-response archive is retained in TRIDENT_REAL_EVIDENCE_20260925.zip / full bundle; ordinary PR Git carries measured CSVs, selected plan files and check summaries.
figures: Paper plots are reproducible from committed CSVs with plot_local_evidence.py / plot_paper.py; binary figure copies are kept in the delivery package rather than required for solving.
available_seed_responses: Selected plan JSON files are committed; compressed official responses are in the complete evidence package.
